title: Pagination off-by-one
diff:
def get_page(items, page_size, page_num):
    """Return the slice of items for the given page (1-indexed)."""
    start = page_num * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    return items[start:end]
ground_truth_bug: page_num is 1-indexed per the docstring, but start uses page_num * page_size instead of (page_num - 1) * page_size, so page 1 skips the first page_size items entirely.
